QUOTE: The asm is gated on `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GNU-compatible (`__GNUC__`) or ARM Compiler (`__ARMCC_VERSION`) (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros, which conveys it is derived. It never says "not set in mbedtls_config.h", but the mechanism is stated.
